english:
Being within 15 meters of 3 or more enemies grants 30 Handling and 10% decreased Handling Animation Duration. Swords also receive 30 Charge Rate.

Scoring 3 Kills within 4 seconds while surrounded grants a stack of Armor Charge.

The condition lingers for 1.5 seconds once it is no longer met.
